reply: The game room TV is now playable. Walk up to it (the hint at the bottom says 'E play TV games') and press E: the TV turns on with a game list (Snake, plus Pong, Tetris and Car Race shown as coming soon). Use ↑/↓ to choose and Enter to play. Snake runs on the TV with arrows or WASD, and the score and best score are shown. Press F to go full screen and F again to return to the TV. Backspace goes back to the list, and E in the list turns the TV off. While the TV is on, walking, doors and the C/X/L suggestion keys are paused so they don't clash with the game. Code: src/arcade.js (wired up in src/main.js).
